**FWJP** disables Amazon Japan's security stack and spoofs your device identity so the app sees a fresh device on every reset.

**What it does:**
- Disables Kavach SDK (proxy/VPN/screenshot monitoring)
- Bypasses jailbreak, debugger, hook, and dylib detection
- Spoofs IDFV, device serial, and fraud metadata fingerprint
- Forces Amazon Japan locale (ja_JP) so the app opens amazon.co.jp
- Floating ⚡ overlay: live hook log, Reset & Spoof button, Device Info panel

- Fixed floating ⚡ overlay not appearing on iOS 16 (UIWindowScene fix)
- Added NSLocale hook to force amazon.co.jp instead of amazon.com
- Fixed panel presenter on iOS 13+

- Initial release
- Kavach SDK bypass
- Identity spoofing (IDFV, serial, fingerprint)
- Floating overlay with reset and device info
